info.sbwloadertest.tom_7: The Tom-7 is a 'fixed-wing aircraft' from the cartoon Tom and Jerry. It seats one pilot and carries a single devastating Watermelon Bomb.
sbwloadertest.page.vehicle.tom_7.1: $(thing)Tom-7$() is extremely simple plane with weak armor protection. It can carry a $(thing)Melon$() as weapon.
